title: The Recurrence
thesis: The Interval named a single gap. The Recurrence names the fact that the gap is structural: every seventh day the record closes and reopens on schedule, whether or not anything is ready to fill it. This week opens on exactly that condition — Issue 7 sealed cleanly, for once without a stranger, a halt, or a dark waker, and Issue 8 opens with no feature drafted and no thesis chosen for it, because the two candidates (E17 The Audited House, E18 The Message Board) are still mid-review and land, if they land, only when the re-reading (~09-09) and the next comb (09-10) fall inside this week rather than before it. The record continues on the recurring form while the editorial question that has carried since Issue 6 recurs unresolved into a third issue.
